<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Generador de Documentos DARH</title>
<style>
:root{
  --az:#003F8A;--az2:#002660;--az3:#1565C0;--dor:#C9A84C;
  --cel:#EEF4FB;--celb:#C5D9F0;--gbg:#DDE1E8;--gp:#F5F6F8;
  --gb:#D0D6E0;--tx:#1A2535;--su:#5A6478;--vd:#1A7A4A;
  --hn:#FFECC8;--hf:#C8EFCF;--hl:#C4EBF2;--hd:#FFD6DB;--he:#DDD0FF;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
img{border:none!important;outline:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;}
body{font-family:Calibri,'Barlow',sans-serif;background:var(--gbg);color:var(--tx);font-size:15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.hdr{background:linear-gradient(92deg,var(--az2) 0%,var(--az) 55%,#1457B3 100%);border-bottom:3px solid var(--dor);flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.28);}
.hdr-i{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:9px 20px;}
.hdr-logo{height:50px;width:auto;border-radius:3px;flex-shrink:0;}
.hdr-sep{width:1px;height:38px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);flex-shrink:0;}
.hdr-t h1{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.15;}
.hdr-t p{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px;}
.hdr-b{margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:20px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.ws{flex:1;display:flex;overflow:hidden;min-height:0;}
/* MENU */
.mc{width:270px;flex-shrink:0;background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--gb);overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.ms{border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);}
.msh{padding:10px 12px;font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;}
.msh.sup{background:#E8F2FB;color:var(--az);border-left:3px solid var(--az);}
.msh.sub{background:#E3EDF8;color:var(--az3);border-left:3px solid var(--az3);}
.msh.sup svg{color:var(--az);}
.msh.cert{background:#E8F5EF;color:#1A7A4A;border-left:3px solid #1A7A4A;}
.msh.perf{background:#FFF3E0;color:#E65100;border-left:3px solid #E65100;}
.msh.it{background:#E6F4F5;color:#0C7A8A;border-left:3px solid #0C7A8A;}
.msh.opos{background:#FBE8ED;color:#9C2B4E;border-left:3px solid #9C2B4E;}
.msh .arr{margin-left:auto;font-size:9px;transition:transform .2s;}
.msh.open .arr{transform:rotate(90deg);}
.mi{display:none;padding:5px 0;}
.mi.open{display:block;}
.mb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;width:100%;padding:8px 12px 8px 20px;background:none;border:none;border-left:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font-family:Calibri,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--tx);text-align:left;transition:background .14s;}
.mb:hover{background:var(--cel);color:var(--az);}
.mb.act{background:var(--az);color:#fff;font-weight:600;border-left-color:var(--dor);}
.mb.dis{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none;}
.mtag{font-size:9px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--celb);color:var(--az);font-weight:700;margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;}
.mb.act .mtag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;}
.stag{font-size:9px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:7px;background:#E3EDF8;color:var(--az3);font-weight:600;margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;}
.mt{margin-top:auto;padding:10px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--gb);font-size:11px;color:var(--su);line-height:1.7;}
.mfolder{padding:6px 12px 0 12px;}
.mfolder-hdr{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--su);padding:4px 6px;background:var(--gbg);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-bottom:2px;}
.mfolder-hdr .farr{margin-left:auto;font-size:9px;transition:transform .2s;}
.mfolder-hdr.fopen .farr{transform:rotate(90deg);}
.mfolder-items{display:none;padding-left:8px;}
.mfolder-items.fopen{display:block;}
.mt strong{color:var(--az);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
/* FORM */
.fc{width:560px;flex-shrink:0;background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--gb);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;}
.ch{padding:10px 14px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--az);color:#fff;font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.ch .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--dor);flex-shrink:0;}
.fs{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:12px 14px;}
.fsc{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;background:var(--fsc-bg,linear-gradient(90deg,#003F8A,#1565C0));padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;margin:16px 0 10px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,63,138,.2);}
.fsc:first-child{margin-top:0;}
.fi{margin-bottom:8px;}
label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px;}
label.le{color:#6F42C1;} label.ll{color:#0C7A8A;} label.ln{color:#8B4513;}
label.lf{color:var(--vd);} label.ld{color:#A01020;} label.lr{color:var(--az2);}
input[type="date"],input[type=date]{text-align:left;-webkit-appearance:none;}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;font-family:Calibri,sans-serif;font-size:14px;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--gb);border-radius:5px;background:#fff;color:var(--tx);transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;box-sizing:border-box;height:36px;line-height:1.4;}
textarea{height:auto;min-height:70px;resize:vertical;}
input:focus,select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--az);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,63,138,.12);}
input.ie,select.ie{border-left:3px solid #6F42C1;}
input.il,select.il{border-left:3px solid #0C7A8A;}
input.in,select.in{border-left:3px solid #8B4513;}
input.if2{text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-sizing:border-box;}
input.id,select.id{border-left:3px solid #A01020;}
input.ir,select.ir{border-left:3px solid var(--az2);}
select{cursor:pointer;}
.fr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}
.fr4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}



.bn-g{background:var(--vd);color:#fff;} .bn-g:hover{background:#155f38;}
.bn-r{background:#B5460F;color:#fff;} .bn-r:hover{background:#8e370b;}
.bn-o{background:#fff;color:var(--az);border:1.5px solid var(--az);} .bn-o:hover{background:var(--cel);}
/* PREVIEW */
.pc{flex:1;min-width:0;background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;}
.ph{padding:9px 16px;flex-shrink:0;background:#263545;color:#fff;font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.ld2{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#2ECC71;animation:blk 2s infinite;}
@keyframes blk{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
.ps2{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;background:#fff;padding:20px 16px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;}
.ep{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;color:#888;text-align:center;padding:60px;width:100%;}
.ep svg{opacity:.2;}
.ep h3{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:16px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;}
/* PAPER */
.paper{background:#fff;width:100%;max-width:860px;min-height:100%;box-shadow:0 4px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22);padding:1.75cm 1.9cm 2.54cm 1.9cm;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:11pt;color:#000;line-height:1.5;}
.p-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:14pt;}
.p-logo-col{flex-shrink:0;width:4.6cm;min-width:4.6cm;max-width:4.6cm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
.p-logo{height:3.5cm;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain;border:none!important;outline:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent;}
.p-logo-meta{font-size:8.5pt;line-height:1.5;margin-top:5pt;color:#222;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;}
.p-logo-meta p{margin:0;padding:0;}
.p-ref-block{flex:1;}
.p-ref{font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 8pt 0;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;width:100%;}
.p-num{text-align:left;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;margin-bottom:0;padding-left:1.5cm;margin-top:4pt;}
.p-citydate{text-align:right;font-size:11pt;margin-bottom:14pt;padding-left:1.5cm;}
.p-stitle{font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:center;}
.p-item{display:flex;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify;font-size:11pt;line-height:1.5;}
.p-num-lbl{flex-shrink:0;width:2em;}
.p-item-text{flex:1;text-indent:0;}
.p-gap{margin-bottom:12pt;}
.p-anote{font-weight:bold;text-align:center;margin:18pt 0;font-size:11pt;}
.p-firma{margin-top:54pt;font-size:11pt;}
.p-foot-exp{font-size:11pt;margin-top:14pt;}
.p-footer{margin-top:8pt;border-top:1pt solid #000;padding-top:5pt;font-size:9pt;text-align:center;color:#222;}
.p-pagenum{text-align:center;font-size:9pt;margin-top:4pt;}
.hl-exp{background:var(--he);border-radius:2px;padding:0 1px;}
.hl-lugar{background:var(--hl);border-radius:2px;padding:0 1px;}
.hl-nom{background:var(--hn);border-radius:2px;padding:0 1px;}
.hl-fecha{background:var(--hf);border-radius:2px;padding:0 1px;}
.hl-der{background:var(--hd);border-radius:2px;padding:0 1px;}
[contenteditable]:hover{background:rgba(0,63,138,.05);outline:1px dashed rgba(0,63,138,.25);cursor:text;}
[contenteditable]:focus{outline:1.5px solid rgba(0,63,138,.4);background:rgba(0,63,138,.04);}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE MOBILE — bottom tab bar always visible
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Tab bar — hidden on desktop, shown on mobile via media query */

@media (max-width: 900px){

  /* Show tab bar */
  
  /* Body: no overflow hidden so fixed positioning works */
  html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;position:relative;}

  /* Workspace: flex row but clipped, above tab bar */
  .ws{
    height:calc(100vh - var(--hdr-h,62px) - 56px);
    overflow:hidden;
    position:relative;
  }

  /* All 3 panels: fixed, full screen minus header and tab bar */
  .mc,.fc,.pc{
    position:fixed !important;
    top:var(--hdr-h,62px);
    left:0;right:0;bottom:56px;
    width:100% !important;max-width:100% !important;
    overflow:hidden;
    display:flex !important;flex-direction:column;
    transform:translateX(105%);
    transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    z-index:50;border-right:none !important;
  }


  /* Preview panel: scroll via internal .ps2, not the panel itself */
  .pc{overflow:hidden;display:flex !important;flex-direction:column;}
    /* Active panel visible */
  .mc.mob-active,
  .fc.mob-active,
  .pc.mob-active{
    transform:translateX(0) !important;
  }

  /* Menu starts visible */
  .mc{transform:translateX(0);}

  /* Header compact */
  .hdr-t p{display:none;}
  .hdr-b{display:none;}
  .hdr-acgs{display:none;}
  .hdr-sep{display:none;}
  .hdr-logo{height:36px;}
  .hdr-t h1{font-size:14px;}
  .hdr-i{padding:7px 12px;gap:10px;}

  /* Form layout */
  .fc{width:560px;flex-shrink:0;background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--gb);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;}
  .fs{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:10px 12px;}
  
  
  

  /* Menu touch targets */
  .mb{padding:11px 14px 11px 18px;font-size:15px;}
  .msh{padding:12px 12px;}
  .mfolder-hdr{padding:8px 8px;font-size:13px;}

  /* Paper */
  .paper{
    padding:12px 10px 18px;
    font-size:10pt;
    max-width:100%;
    box-shadow:none;
  }
  .p-logo-col{flex-shrink:0;width:2.6cm;min-width:2.6cm;max-width:2.6cm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
  .p-logo{height:2.0cm;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain;border:none!important;outline:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;}
  .p-ref{font-size:9pt;text-align:justify;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 5pt 0;}
  .p-num{font-size:10pt;}
  .p-citydate{font-size:10pt;}
  .p-stitle{font-size:10pt;}
  .p-item{font-size:10pt;}
  .ps2{padding:10px 6px;align-items:flex-start;}

  /* Form grid: single column */
  .fr{grid-template-columns:1fr;}

  /* Preview background */
  .pc{background:#fff;}

  /* Mobile header fixes */
  .p-logo{height:2.0cm;width:auto;display:block;}
  .p-logo-meta{font-size:7pt;line-height:1.3;margin-top:2pt;}
  .p-title-col{padding-left:0.25cm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
  .p-ref{font-size:9pt;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 5pt 0;}
  .p-resol-num{font-size:9pt;margin:0 0 3pt 0;}
  .p-city{font-size:9pt;margin:0 0 6pt 0;}
  .p-visto{font-size:10pt;margin:8pt 0 3pt 0;text-align:center;}
  .p-item{margin-bottom:3pt;}
  .p-item-text{font-size:9.5pt;line-height:1.4;}
  .p-num-lbl{font-size:9.5pt;}
  .p-cert{font-size:9.5pt;line-height:1.4;}
  .p-anote{font-size:10pt;}
  .p-firma{margin:16pt 0 4pt 0;}
  .p-footer{font-size:7pt;}

  .p-logo{height:2.0cm;width:auto;display:block;}
  .p-logo-meta{font-size:7pt;line-height:1.3;margin-top:2pt;}
  .p-title-col{padding-left:0.25cm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
  .p-ref{font-size:9pt;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 5pt 0;}
  .p-resol-num{font-size:9pt;margin:0 0 3pt 0;}
  .p-city{font-size:9pt;margin:0 0 6pt 0;}
  .p-visto{font-size:10pt;margin:8pt 0 3pt 0;text-align:center;}
  .p-item-text{font-size:9.5pt;line-height:1.4;}
  .p-num-lbl{font-size:9.5pt;}
  .p-cert{font-size:9.5pt;line-height:1.4;}
  .p-firma{margin:16pt 0 4pt 0;}

  /* Mobile document header overrides */
  .p-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:8pt;}
  .p-resol-num{font-size:9pt;margin:0 0 2pt 0;}
  .p-city{font-size:9pt;margin:0 0 6pt 0;}
  .p-logo-meta{font-size:7pt;line-height:1.3;margin-top:2pt;}
  .p-logo-meta p{margin:0;}
  .p-visto{font-size:10pt;margin:6pt 0 2pt 0;text-align:center;}
  .p-item{margin-bottom:2pt;}
  .p-item-text{font-size:9.5pt;line-height:1.4;}
  .p-num-lbl{font-size:9.5pt;}
  .p-cert{font-size:9.5pt;line-height:1.4;}
  .p-anote{font-size:10pt;margin:10pt 0 6pt 0;}
  .p-firma{margin:14pt 0 4pt 0;}
  .p-foot-exp{font-size:9pt;}
  .p-footer{font-size:7pt;}
  /* Preview scroll on mobile */
  #pwrap{width:100%;padding:8px;box-sizing:border-box;align-items:flex-start;}
  #pwrap .paper{max-width:100%;box-shadow:none;padding:10px 8px 16px;}
  /* Show mobile tab bar */
  .mob-tabs{display:flex!important;}
}

@media (max-width: 480px){
  .p-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:14pt;}
  .p-logo-col{flex-shrink:0;width:4.6cm;min-width:4.6cm;max-width:4.6cm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
  .p-logo{height:3.5cm;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain;border:none!important;outline:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent;}
  .p-ref-block{width:100%;}
  .p-citydate{text-align:left;}
  .hdr-logo{height:30px;}
  .hdr-t h1{font-size:12px;}
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════
   USER / LOGIN SYSTEM
   ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
#login-overlay{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--az) 0%,#001f5c 100%);
  z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  overflow-y:auto;padding:20px;box-sizing:border-box;
}
.login-box{
  background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:28px 24px;width:90%;max-width:400px;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);box-sizing:border-box;
  max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;
}
.login-box .lb-logo{display:block;height:60px;width:auto;margin:0 auto 18px;border:none;background:transparent;object-fit:contain;}
.login-box h2{text-align:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--az);margin:0 0 6px;}
.login-box p{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--su);margin:0 0 24px;}
.login-box label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--az);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;margin-bottom:5px;}
.login-box input{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--gb);border-radius:8px;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:14px;box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;}
.login-box input:focus{border-color:var(--az);}
.login-btn{width:100%;padding:14px;background:var(--az);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px;-webkit-appearance:none;touch-action:manipulation;}
.login-btn:hover{background:#002a7a;}
.login-err{color:#c0392b;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;margin-top:10px;display:none;padding:8px;background:#ffeaea;border-radius:5px;}

/* User badge in header */
#user-badge{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:20px;
  padding:5px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);flex-shrink:0;
}
#user-badge:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
#user-badge svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:#fff;}

/* User panel */
#user-panel{
  position:fixed;top:58px;right:12px;width:300px;
  background:#fff;border-radius:10px;z-index:500;
  box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  border:1px solid var(--gb);display:none;
}
#user-panel.open{display:block;}
.up-hdr{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);
  font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--az);}
.up-info{padding:10px 16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--su);border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);}
.up-info span{font-weight:600;color:var(--tx);}
.up-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:10px 16px;
  border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;color:var(--tx);
  text-align:left;transition:background .12s;}
.up-btn:hover{background:#f4f7fb;}
.up-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:currentColor;flex-shrink:0;}
.up-btn.danger{color:#c0392b;}

/* User Manager modal */
#user-mgr{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:600;display:none;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
#user-mgr.open{display:flex;}
.um-box{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;width:520px;max-height:80vh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
.um-hdr{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);display:flex;
  align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.um-hdr h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--az);margin:0;}
.um-close{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:20px;color:var(--su);}
.um-body{padding:16px 20px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;}
.um-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.um-form input,.um-form select{
  padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--gb);border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;
  box-sizing:border-box;height:34px;}
.um-form .full{grid-column:1/-1;}
.um-add-btn{grid-column:1/-1;padding:8px;background:var(--vd);color:#fff;
  border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;}
.um-list{border:1px solid var(--gb);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;}
.um-list-hdr{background:#f4f7fb;padding:8px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--su);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto auto;gap:8px;}
.um-user-row{padding:9px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--gb);font-size:12px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;}
.um-user-row:hover{background:#f9fbff;}
.um-role{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;}
.um-role.super{background:#e8f0fe;color:#1a56db;}
.um-role.regional{background:#def7ec;color:#03543f;}
.um-del-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:#c0392b;font-size:16px;padding:2px 6px;}

/* Activity log modal */
#log-modal{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:600;display:none;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
#log-modal.open{display:flex;}
.lm-box{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;width:620px;max-height:80vh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
.lm-hdr{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);display:flex;
  align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.lm-hdr h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--az);margin:0;}
.lm-body{padding:0;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;}
.lm-row{padding:10px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);font-size:12px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 100px 110px 110px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:start;}
.lm-row:hover{background:#f9fbff;}
.lm-date{color:var(--su);font-size:11px;}
.lm-user{font-weight:700;color:var(--az);}
.lm-doc{color:var(--tx);}
.lm-exp{font-size:10px;color:var(--su);}
.lm-empty{padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--su);font-size:13px;}


/* ══════════════════════════════════════════
   DASHBOARD
   ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
#dash-modal{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);z-index:700;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px;}
#dash-modal.open{display:flex;}
.dash-box{background:#f0f4f9;border-radius:12px;width:900px;max-width:100%;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);margin:auto;}
.dash-hdr{background:var(--az);color:#fff;padding:18px 24px;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.dash-hdr h3{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.dash-close{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 12px;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;}
.dash-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);}
.dash-filters{background:#fff;padding:14px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;}
.dash-filters label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--su);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
.dash-filters input,.dash-filters select{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--gb);border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;height:34px;box-sizing:border-box;}
.df-apply{padding:6px 16px;background:var(--az);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;height:34px;}
.df-apply:hover{background:#002a7a;}
.df-export{padding:6px 16px;background:var(--vd);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;height:34px;}
.dash-body{padding:20px 24px;}
.dash-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.kpi{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07);text-align:center;}
.kpi-n{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:var(--az);line-height:1.1;}
.kpi-l{font-size:11px;color:var(--su);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;margin-top:3px;}
.dash-section{margin-bottom:18px;}
.dash-section h4{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--su);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:0 0 10px;}
.dash-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07);font-size:12px;}
.dash-table th{background:var(--az);color:#fff;padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.dash-table td{padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gb);}
.dash-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
.dash-table tr:hover td{background:#f4f7fb;}
.dash-bar{height:10px;background:var(--az);border-radius:4px;min-width:4px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:8px;opacity:.75;}
@media(max-width:600px){.dash-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.dash-box{width:100%;border-radius:0;}.dash-filters{flex-direction:column;}}


/* ── Dashboard Charts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dash-chart-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.chart-card{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07);}
.chart-card h4{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--su);text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.08em;margin:0 0 14px;}
.chart-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.chart-tab{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid var(--gb);background:#fff;color:var(--su);
  transition:all .15s;}
.chart-tab.active{background:var(--az);color:#fff;border-color:var(--az);}
.bar-chart{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;}
.bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;}
.bar-label{width:130px;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--tx);text-align:right;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.bar-track{flex:1;height:16px;background:#edf2f9;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;}
.bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:8px;transition:width .4s ease;}
.bar-val{width:28px;flex-shrink:0;text-align:right;font-weight:700;color:var(--su);}
.donut-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;}
.donut-svg{flex-shrink:0;}
.donut-legend{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;}
.donut-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;}
.donut-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
.donut-name{flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.donut-pct{font-weight:700;color:var(--su);}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .dash-chart-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .bar-label{width:90px;}
}

/* ── Chile Map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.chile-map-wrap{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:16px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07);
}
.chile-map-wrap h4{
  font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--su);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;
  margin:0 0 12px;align-self:flex-start;
}
.map-container{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;width:100%;}
.map-svg-wrap{flex-shrink:0;position:relative;}
.map-svg-wrap svg{display:block;max-height:500px;}
.region-path{
  stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1.5;cursor:pointer;
  transition:opacity .15s;
}
.region-path:hover{opacity:.8;stroke:#003F8A;stroke-width:2;}
.region-label{
  font-size:5.5px;fill:#fff;font-weight:700;
  pointer-events:none;text-anchor:middle;
  font-family:Calibri,Arial,sans-serif;
}
.map-legend{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.map-legend-title{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--su);margin-bottom:8px;}
.map-legend-scale{display:flex;gap:0;height:12px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:6px;}
.map-legend-scale div{flex:1;}
.map-legend-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;color:var(--su);margin-bottom:12px;}
.map-region-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;max-height:380px;overflow-y:auto;}
.map-region-item{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  font-size:11px;padding:3px 4px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .1s;
}
.map-region-item:hover{background:#f0f4f9;}
.map-region-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0;}
.map-region-name{flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:var(--tx);}
.map-region-count{font-weight:700;color:var(--az);font-size:11px;}
.map-tooltip{
  position:fixed;background:rgba(0,20,60,.92);color:#fff;
  padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
  pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;display:none;white-space:nowrap;
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .map-container{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
  .map-region-list{max-height:200px;}
}


@keyframes shake{
  0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);}
  20%{transform:translateX(-8px);}
  40%{transform:translateX(8px);}
  60%{transform:translateX(-5px);}
  80%{transform:translateX(5px);}
}

.badge-prox{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 5px;
  border-radius:8px;background:#f0a500;color:#fff;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:middle;}
.mb.prx{color:var(--su);opacity:.7;cursor:default;pointer-events:none;}


.msh.sol{background:#EEF0FA;color:#3d3aa0;border-left:3px solid #5a4fcf;}
.badge-prox{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 6px;
  border-radius:8px;background:#f0a500;color:#fff;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:middle;
  letter-spacing:.03em;}
.mb.prx{opacity:.6;cursor:default;pointer-events:none;font-style:italic;}


/* Certificate paragraph — block layout, no flex columns */
.p-cert{display:block;text-align:justify;font-size:11pt;line-height:1.6;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;margin:0 0 8pt 0;}
/* Mobile tab active state — hardcoded to avoid CSS var resolution issues */


/* ── Mobile tabs ── */
.mob-tabs{
  display:none;
  position:fixed; bottom:0; left:0; right:0;
  height:56px;
  background:#fff;
  border-top:1.5px solid #e2e8f0;
  z-index:1000;
  box-shadow:0 -2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
.mob-tab{
  flex:1;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:3px;
  border:none;
  background:transparent;
  cursor:pointer;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.07em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#6b7a8f;
  padding:6px 0;
  position:relative;
  border-top:3px solid transparent;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  outline:none;
  -webkit-appearance:none;
}
.mob-tab svg{
  width:22px; height:22px;
  stroke:#6b7a8f;
  transition:stroke .15s;
}
.mob-tab[data-active="1"]{
  color:#003F8A;
  background:rgba(0,63,138,.07);
  border-top:3px solid #003F8A;
}
.mob-tab[data-active="1"] svg{
  stroke:#003F8A;
}
.mob-tabs{display:none;}


/* ── Paper body sections ── */
.p-body{padding:0;}
.p-visto{font-weight:700;margin:10pt 0 4pt 0;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;text-align:center;}
.p-gap{height:6pt;}
.p-anote{font-weight:700;margin:14pt 0 8pt 0;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;}
.p-firma{margin:28pt 0 6pt 0;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;}
.p-foot-exp{margin:8pt 0 4pt 0;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:10pt;color:#444;}
.p-pagenum{text-align:right;font-size:9pt;color:#888;margin-top:6pt;}
.p-cert{display:block;text-align:justify;font-size:11pt;line-height:1.6;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;margin:0 0 8pt 0;}

/* ── Print / @page ── */
@media print{
  body{background:#fff!important;}
  .hdr,.fc,.mob-tabs,.no-print{display:none!important;}
  /* removed conflicting pwrap/paper rule */
}
@page{size:21.59cm 33.02cm;margin:1.75cm 1.9cm 2.54cm 1.9cm;}


/* ── Header title column ── */
.p-title-col{flex:1;padding-left:1.0cm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
.p-inst{display:none;}
.p-resol{display:none;}
.p-resol-num{font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;margin:0 0 4pt 0;}

/* ── Login overlay ── */
.login-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,20,60,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);z-index:9000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.login-box{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:36px 32px 28px;width:100%;max-width:400px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.22);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
.login-logo{height:72px;width:auto;margin-bottom:4px;}
.login-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--az);letter-spacing:-.01em;text-align:center;}
.login-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--su);text-align:center;margin-top:-8px;}
.login-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--su);text-transform:uppercase;align-self:flex-start;}
.login-input{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--gb);border-radius:9px;
  font-size:15px;box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;transition:border .15s;}
.login-input:focus{border-color:var(--az);}
.login-btn{width:100%;padding:13px;background:var(--az);color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;
  border:none;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-top:4px;}
.login-btn:hover{background:#00306a;}
.login-err{color:#c0392b;font-size:13px;display:none;text-align:center;}

/* pwrap controlled by JS */


.p-ref{font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 8pt 0;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;width:100%;}

/* Panel visibility by ID - belt and suspenders for Safari iOS */
#panel-menu.mob-active,
#panel-form.mob-active,
#panel-preview.mob-active {
  transform: translateX(0) !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

#pwrap{display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:20px;gap:16px;box-sizing:border-box;}

/* Preview visibility - class based for reliability */
#pwrap.preview-active {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 20px;
  gap: 16px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Header action buttons */
.ch-act{margin-left:auto;display:none;gap:4px;flex-shrink:0;align-items:center;}
.ch-act.visible{display:flex;}
.bn-ch{padding:7px 12px;border-radius:5px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;white-space:nowrap;min-height:36px;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-appearance:none;}
.bn-ch-g{background:#27ae60;color:#fff;}
.bn-ch-r{background:#c0392b;color:#fff;}
.bn-ch:active{opacity:0.8;}

/* Page break for fondos autorización */
.page-break-before{page-break-before:always;break-before:page;}
@media print{
  .page-break-before{page-break-before:always;break-before:page;margin-top:0!important;padding-top:0!important;}
  .paper{page-break-inside:auto;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="hdr">
  
<!-- LOGIN OVERLAY -->
<div id="login-overlay">
  <div class="login-box">
    <img class="lb-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," id="login-logo" alt="DGA">
    <h2>Generador de Documentos DARH</h2>
    <p>Dirección General de Aguas — Ingrese sus credenciales</p>
    <label>Usuario</label>
    <input type="text" id="login-user" placeholder="nombre.apellido" autocomplete="username" autocorrect="off" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false">
    <label>Contraseña</label>
    <div class="login-pass-wrap" style="position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;">
      <input type="password" id="login-pass" placeholder="••••••••" autocomplete="current-password" autocorrect="off" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false" style="padding-right:46px!important;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;">
      <button type="button" id="login-eye" aria-label="Ver contraseña" title="Ver contraseña" onclick="(function(){var p=document.getElementById('login-pass');var b=document.getElementById('login-eye');if(!p)return;var show=p.type==='password';p.type=show?'text':'password';if(b)b.textContent=show?'🙈':'👁';})();" style="position:absolute;right:8px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:34px;height:34px;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:2;">👁</button>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="login-btn" id="login-btn" onclick="doLogin()" ontouchstart="" style="cursor:pointer;">Ingresar</button>
    <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #eee;"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Agua con gestión, agua con solución" style="width:160px;height:auto;border:none;outline:none;opacity:.85;"></div>
    <p class="login-err" id="login-err">Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- USER BADGE (header) -->
<span id="user-badge" onclick="toggleUserPanel()" style="display:none;">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 20c0-4 3.6-7 8-7s8 3 8 7"/></svg>
  <span id="user-badge-name">—</span>
</span>

<!-- USER PANEL -->
<div id="user-panel">
  <div class="up-hdr" id="up-name">—</div>
  <div class="up-info">Región: <span id="up-region">—</span></div>
  <div class="up-info">Rol: <span id="up-rol">—</span></div>
  <button class="up-btn" onclick="showLog()">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/><line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/><line x1="16" y1="17" x2="13" y2="17"/></svg>
    Historial de documentos
  </button>
  <button class="up-btn" id="btn-dashboard" onclick="showDash()" style="display:none;">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7"/></svg>
    Dashboard Nacional
  </button>
  <button class="up-btn" id="btn-mgr-users" onclick="showUserMgr()" style="display:none;">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>
    Gestionar usuarios
  </button>
  <button class="up-btn danger" onclick="doLogout()">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"/><polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"/><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/></svg>
    Cerrar sesión
  </button>
</div>

<!-- USER MANAGER MODAL -->
<div id="user-mgr">
  <div class="um-box">
    <div class="um-hdr">
      <h3>👥 Gestión de Usuarios</h3>
      <button class="um-close" onclick="document.getElementById('user-mgr').classList.remove('open')">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="um-body">
      <div class="um-form">
        <input id="nu-user" placeholder="Usuario (ej: juan.perez)">
        <input id="nu-pass" type="password" placeholder="Contraseña">
        <input id="nu-nombre" placeholder="Nombre completo" class="full">
        <select id="nu-rol"><option value="regional">Regional</option><option value="super">Superusuario</option></select>
        <select id="nu-region" class="um-reg"></select>
        <button class="um-add-btn" onclick="addUser()">+ Agregar usuario</button>
      </div>
      <div class="um-list">
        <div class="um-list-hdr"><span>Usuario</span><span>Nombre</span><span>Región</span><span>Rol</span></div>
        <div id="um-list-body"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ACTIVITY LOG MODAL -->
<div id="log-modal">
  <div class="lm-box">

var curDoc = '';
var _userEdited = false;

// Returns live DOM HTML if user edited; otherwise re-renders from form
function getDocHTML(){
  var paper = document.getElementById('doc-paper');
  if(!paper){
    var pw = document.getElementById('pwrap');
    if(pw){ var ds = pw.querySelectorAll('.paper'); if(ds&&ds.length) paper = ds[0]; }
  }
  if(_userEdited && paper && paper.innerHTML.trim().length > 100){
    return paper.outerHTML;
  }
  // No user edits — re-render from form data
  render();
  paper = document.getElementById('doc-paper');
  if(!paper){
    var pw2 = document.getElementById('pwrap');
    if(pw2){ var ds2 = pw2.querySelectorAll('.paper'); if(ds2&&ds2.length) paper = ds2[0]; }
  }
  return paper ? paper.outerHTML : null;
}

// Detect user editing in preview
document.addEventListener('input', function(e){
  if(e.target && e.target.isContentEditable){
    var pw = document.getElementById('pwrap');
    if(pw && pw.contains && pw.contains(e.target)){ _userEdited = true; }
  }
});

function _lsDel(k){try{localStorage.removeItem(k);}catch(e){delete _memStore[k];}}

// Si la versión cambió, limpiar todo y recargar lista maestra
(function(){
  if(_lsGet('darh_users_version')!==USERS_VERSION){
    _lsDel(USERS_KEY);_lsDel(SESSION_KEY);
    _lsSet('darh_users_version',USERS_VERSION);
  }
})();

function getUsers(){
  // Siempre validar contra MASTER_USERS: si hay usuarios en LS se usan,
  // pero el login siempre acepta credenciales del MASTER aunque no estén en LS
  var stored=_lsGet(USERS_KEY);
  if(stored){try{return JSON.parse(stored);}catch(e){}}
  _lsSet(USERS_KEY,JSON.stringify(MASTER_USERS));
  return MASTER_USERS;
}
function saveUsers(arr){_lsSet(USERS_KEY,JSON.stringify(arr));}
function getLog(){var l=_lsGet(LOG_KEY);try{return l?JSON.parse(l):[];}catch(e){return [];}}
function addLog(entry){var l=getLog();l.unshift(entry);if(l.length>500)l=l.slice(0,500);_lsSet(LOG_KEY,JSON.stringify(l));}

function logActivity(action){
  if(!currentUser)return;
  var docNames={
    'admisible':'ND Admisible','admisible-deniega':'ND Adm. y Deniega',
    'admisible-inadmisible':'ND Adm. desde Inadm.','deniega':'ND Deniega',
    'desiste':'ND Desiste','inadmisible':'ND Inadmisible',
    'inadmisible-deniega':'ND Inadm. y Deniega','otorga':'ND Otorga',
    'otorga-parte':'ND Otorga en Parte','otorga-prov':'ND Otorga Prov.',
    'otorga-parte-prov':'ND Otorga Parte Prov.',
    'vpc-admisible':'VPC Admisible','vpc-admisible-deniega':'VPC Adm. y Deniega',
    'vpc-admisible-inadmisible':'VPC Adm. desde Inadm.','vpc-inadmisible':'VPC Inadmisible',
    'vpc-inadmisible-deniega':'VPC Inadm. y Deniega','vpc-deniega':'VPC Deniega',
    'vpc-autoriza-total':'VPC Autoriza Total','vpc-autoriza-parcial':'VPC Autoriza Parcial',
    'vpc-desiste':'VPC Desiste','sup-admisible-deniega':'ND Sup Adm. y Deniega',
    'sup-admisible-inadmisible':'ND Sup Adm. desde Inadm.','sup-deniega':'ND Sup Deniega',
    'sup-desiste':'ND Sup Desiste','sup-inadmisible':'ND Sup Inadmisible',
    'sup-inadmisible-deniega':'ND Sup Inadm. y Deniega','sup-otorga':'ND Sup Otorga',
    'sup-otorga-discontinuo':'ND Sup Otorga Discontinuo','sup-otorga-parte':'ND Sup Otorga en Parte',
    'sup-otorga-prov':'ND Sup Otorga Prov.','sup-otorga-parte-prov':'ND Sup Otorga Parte Prov.',
    'nr-admisible':'NR Admisible','nr-admisible-deniega':'NR Adm. y Deniega',
    'nr-admisible-inadmisible':'NR Adm. desde Inadm.','nr-deniega':'NR Deniega',
    'nr-desiste':'NR Desiste','nr-inadmisible':'NR Inadmisible',
    'nr-inadmisible-deniega':'NR Inadm. y Deniega','nr-reconoce':'NR Reconoce',
    'no-oposicion':'Cert. No Oposición'
  };
  var now=new Date(), pad=function(n){return n<10?'0'+n:n;};
  addLog({
    date:pad(now.getDate())+'/'+pad(now.getMonth()+1)+'/'+now.getFullYear()+' '+pad(now.getHours())+':'+pad(now.getMinutes()),
    user:currentUser.user, nombre:currentUser.nombre, region:currentUser.region,
    docName:(docNames[curDoc]||curDoc)+' ['+action+']',
    exp:v('f_exp')||'—', ssd:v('f_ssd')||'—'
  });
}

function doLogin(){
  var userEl=document.getElementById('login-user');
  var passEl=document.getElementById('login-pass');
  var errEl=document.getElementById('login-err');
  if(!userEl||!passEl)return;
  var user=(userEl.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  var pass=(passEl.value||'').trim();
  if(!user||!pass){if(errEl){errEl.textContent='Ingrese usuario y contraseña.';errEl.style.display='block';}return;}
  var users=[];
  try{users=getUsers()||[];}catch(e){users=[];}
  var all=[];
  try{all=users.concat(MASTER_USERS||[]);}catch(e){all=users;}
  var seen={};
  all=all.filter(function(u){var k=((u&&u.user)||'').trim().toLowerCase(); if(!k||seen[k])return false; seen[k]=1; return true;});
  var found=all.find(function(u){return ((u.user||'').trim().toLowerCase()===user)&&String(u.pass||'')===pass;});
  if(!found){
    if(errEl){errEl.textContent='Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.';errEl.style.display='block';}
    var box=document.querySelector('.login-box');
    if(box){box.style.animation='none';setTimeout(function(){box.style.animation='shake .4s ease';},10);}
    return;
  }
  if(errEl)errEl.style.display='none';
  currentUser=found;
  try{_lsSet(SESSION_KEY,JSON.stringify(found));}catch(e){}
  var overlay=document.getElementById('login-overlay');
  if(overlay)overlay.style.display='none';
  var badge=document.getElementById('user-badge');
  if(badge)badge.style.display='flex';
  var bname=document.getElementById('user-badge-name');
  if(bname)bname.textContent=found.nombre.split(' ')[0];
  var upname=document.getElementById('up-name');if(upname)upname.textContent=found.nombre;
  var upreg=document.getElementById('up-region');if(upreg)upreg.textContent=found.region;
  var uprol=document.getElementById('up-rol');if(uprol)uprol.textContent=found.rol==='super'?'Superusuario':'Regional';
  if(found.rol==='super'){
    var bm=document.getElementById('btn-mgr-users');if(bm)bm.style.display='flex';
    var bd=document.getElementById('btn-dashboard');if(bd)bd.style.display='flex';
  }
  var slot=document.getElementById('user-badge-slot');
  var badgeEl=document.getElementById('user-badge');
  if(slot&&badgeEl)slot.appendChild(badgeEl);
}
function doLogout(){currentUser=null;_lsDel(SESSION_KEY);location.reload();}
function toggleUserPanel(){document.getElementById('user-panel').classList.toggle('open');}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var p=document.getElementById('user-panel');
  var b=document.getElementById('user-badge');
  if(p&&b&&!p.contains(e.target)&&!b.contains(e.target))p.classList.remove('open');
});

function showUserMgr(){
  if(!currentUser||currentUser.rol!=='super'){alert('Sin permisos.');return;}
  document.getElementById('user-panel').classList.remove('open');
  renderUserList();
  document.getElementById('user-mgr').classList.add('open');
}
function renderUserList(){
  var users=getUsers();
  document.getElementById('um-list-body').innerHTML=users.map(function(u){
    return '<div class="um-user-row"><span>'+u.user+'</span><span>'+u.nombre+'</span><span>'+u.region+'</span>'+
      '<span class="um-role '+(u.rol==='super'?'super':'regional')+'">'+(u.rol==='super'?'Super':'Regional')+'</span>'+
      (u.user!=='superadmin'?'<button class="um-del-btn" onclick="delUser(\''+u.user+'\')">✕</button>':'<span></span>')+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}
function addUser(){
  var user=document.getElementById('nu-user').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var pass=document.getElementById('nu-pass').value.trim();
  var nombre=document.getElementById('nu-nombre').value.trim();
  var rol=document.getElementById('nu-rol').value;
  var region=document.getElementById('nu-region').value;
  if(!user||!pass||!nombre){alert('Complete todos los campos.');return;}
  var users=getUsers();
  if(users.find(function(u){return u.user===user;})){alert('Usuario ya existe.');return;}
  users.push({user:user,pass:pass,nombre:nombre,rol:rol,region:region});
  saveUsers(users);renderUserList();
  document.getElementById('nu-user').value='';
  document.getElementById('nu-pass').value='';
  document.getElementById('nu-nombre').value='';
}
function delUser(username){
  if(!confirm('¿Eliminar usuario '+username+'?'))return;
  saveUsers(getUsers().filter(function(u){return u.user!==username;}));
  renderUserList();
}
function showLog(){
  document.getElementById('user-panel').classList.remove('open');
  renderLog();document.getElementById('log-modal').classList.add('open');
}
function renderLog(){
  var log=getLog();
  if(currentUser&&currentUser.rol!=='super')log=log.filter(function(l){return l.user===currentUser.user;});
  if(!log.length){document.getElementById('log-body').innerHTML='<div class="lm-empty">Sin actividad registrada.</div>';return;}
  document.getElementById('log-body').innerHTML=log.map(function(l){
    return '<div class="lm-row">'+
      '<span class="lm-date">'+l.date+'</span>'+
      '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--az);font-weight:600;">'+l.exp+'</span>'+
      '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--su);">'+(l.ssd||'—')+'</span>'+
      '<span class="lm-user" style="font-size:11px;">'+l.nombre+'</span>'+
      '<span class="lm-doc">'+l.docName+'</span>'+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}
function exportLogExcel(){
  var log=getLog();
  if(currentUser&&currentUser.rol!=='super')log=log.filter(function(l){return l.user===currentUser.user;});
  if(!log.length){alert('Sin datos para exportar.');return;}
  var rows=[['Fecha','Expediente','N° SSD','Usuario','Nombre','Región','Documento']];
  log.forEach(function(l){rows.push([l.date,l.exp,l.ssd||'—',l.user,l.nombre,l.region,l.docName]);});
  var xml='<?xml version="1.0"?><?mso-application progid="Excel.Sheet"?>'+
    '<Workbook xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet" xmlns:ss="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet">'+
    '<Styles><Style ss:ID="H"><Font ss:Bold="1"/><Interior ss:Color="#003F8A" ss:Pattern="Solid"/><Font ss:Color="#FFFFFF" ss:Bold="1"/></Style></Styles>'+
    '<Worksheet ss:Name="Historial DARH"><Table>';
  rows.forEach(function(row,ri){
    xml+='<Row>';
    row.forEach(function(cell){
      xml+='<Cell'+(ri===0?' ss:StyleID="H"':'')+'><Data ss:Type="String">'+String(cell).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')+'</Data></Cell>';
    });
    xml+='</Row>';
  });
  xml+='</Table></Worksheet></Workbook>';
  try{
    var blob=new Blob([xml],{type:'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8'});
    var a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download='Historial_DARH_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.xls';
    document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }catch(e){alert('Error al exportar: '+e.message);}
}

function showDash(){
  if(!currentUser||currentUser.rol!=='super'){alert('Sin permisos.');return;}
  document.getElementById('user-panel').classList.remove('open');
  var now=new Date(), d30=new Date(now-30*24*3600*1000);
  var fmt=function(d){return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);};
  var dsd=document.getElementById('df-desde'), dsh=document.getElementById('df-hasta');
  if(dsd&&!dsd.value)dsd.value=fmt(d30);
  if(dsh&&!dsh.value)dsh.value=fmt(now);
  var rsel=document.getElementById('df-region');
  if(rsel&&rsel.options.length<=1)Object.keys(GEO).forEach(function(r){var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=r;o.textContent=r;rsel.appendChild(o);});
  var usel=document.getElementById('df-user');
  if(usel&&usel.options.length<=1)getUsers().forEach(function(u){var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=u.user;o.textContent=u.nombre+' ('+u.user+')';usel.appendChild(o);});
  document.getElementById('dash-modal').classList.add('open');
  renderDash();
}

function getFilteredLog(dedup){
  var log=getLog();
  var desde=document.getElementById('df-desde')?document.getElementById('df-desde').value:'';
  var hasta=document.getElementById('df-hasta')?document.getElementById('df-hasta').value:'';
  var region=document.getElementById('df-region')?document.getElementById('df-region').value:'';
  var user=document.getElementById('df-user')?document.getElementById('df-user').value:'';
  var filtered=log.filter(function(l){
    var parts=l.date.split(' ')[0].split('/');
    var d=parts[2]+'-'+parts[1]+'-'+parts[0];
    if(desde&&d<desde)return false;
    if(hasta&&d>hasta)return false;
    if(region&&l.region!==region)return false;
    if(user&&l.user!==user)return false;
    return true;
  });
  if(!dedup)return filtered;
  var seen={};
  return filtered.filter(function(l){
    var docType=l.docName.replace(' [Word]','').replace(' [PDF]','');
    var key=l.user+'|'+(l.exp||'—')+'|'+docType;
    if(seen[key])return false;seen[key]=true;return true;
  });
}

function renderDash(){
  var log=getFilteredLog(true);
  var body=document.getElementById('dash-body');
  if(!body)return;
  if(!log.length){body.innerHTML='<div style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:var(--su);">No hay actividad en el período seleccionado.</div>';return;}
  function getCategory(docName){
    var d=docName.replace(' [Word]','').replace(' [PDF]','');
    if(d.indexOf('NR ')===0||d.indexOf('NR-')===0)return 'NR';
    if(d.indexOf('Cert.')===0||d.indexOf('No Oposición')>=0)return 'Certificados';
    return 'ND';
  }
  var total=log.length;
  var expSet={};log.forEach(function(l){if(l.exp&&l.exp!=='—')expSet[l.exp]=1;});
  var expedientes=Object.keys(expSet).length;
  var regSet={};log.forEach(function(l){if(l.region)regSet[l.region]=1;});
  var regiones=Object.keys(regSet).length;
  var usrSet={};log.forEach(function(l){usrSet[l.user]=1;});
  var usuarios=Object.keys(usrSet).length;
  var byCat={ND:0,NR:0,Certificados:0};
  log.forEach(function(l){byCat[getCategory(l.docName)]++;});
  var byRegion={};
  log.forEach(function(l){byRegion[l.region]=(byRegion[l.region]||0)+1;});
  var regionRows=Object.entries(byRegion).sort(function(a,b){return b[1]-a[1];});
  var maxR=regionRows.length?regionRows[0][1]:1;
  var byUser={};
  log.forEach(function(l){if(!byUser[l.user])byUser[l.user]={nombre:l.nombre,region:l.region,n:0};byUser[l.user].n++;});
  var userRows=Object.entries(byUser).sort(function(a,b){return b[1].n-a[1].n;});
  function getDocsByCat(cat){
    var map={};
    log.filter(function(l){return getCategory(l.docName)===cat;}).forEach(function(l){var dn=l.docName.replace(' [Word]','').replace(' [PDF]','');map[dn]=(map[dn]||0)+1;});
    return Object.entries(map).sort(function(a,b){return b[1]-a[1];});
  }
  var COLORS=['#003F8A','#1a7ac7','#3daee9','#6cb6e8','#a8d4f5','#c5e3ff','#0e7c4a','#2ab07a','#4ecda7','#8be0c8','#f0a500','#f7cc6a'];
  function mkBar(label,val,max,color){
    var pct=max?Math.round(val/max*100):0;
    return '<div class="bar-row"><div class="bar-label" title="'+label+'">'+label+'</div>'+
      '<div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:'+pct+'%;background:'+color+'"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="bar-val">'+val+'</div></div>';
  }
  function mkDonut(data){
    var tot=data.reduce(function(s,d){return s+d[1];},0)||1;
    var r=52,cx=60,cy=60,stroke=20,offset=0,arcs='';
    data.slice(0,8).forEach(function(d,i){
      var pct=d[1]/tot,dash=pct*2*Math.PI*r,gap=2*Math.PI*r-dash;
      arcs+='<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="'+r+'" fill="none" stroke="'+COLORS[i%COLORS.length]+'" stroke-width="'+stroke+'" stroke-dasharray="'+dash.toFixed(2)+' '+gap.toFixed(2)+'" stroke-dashoffset="'+(-offset*2*Math.PI*r).toFixed(2)+'" transform="rotate(-90 '+cx+' '+cy+')"/>';
      offset+=pct;
    });
    var legend=data.slice(0,8).map(function(d,i){
      return '<div class="donut-item"><div class="donut-dot" style="background:'+COLORS[i%COLORS.length]+'"></div><div class="donut-name" title="'+d[0]+'">'+d[0]+'</div><div class="donut-pct">'+Math.round(d[1]/tot*100)+'%</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    return '<div class="donut-wrap"><svg class="donut-svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 120 120"><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="52" fill="none" stroke="#edf2f9" stroke-width="20"/>'+arcs+'<text x="60" y="55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#003F8A">'+tot+'</text><text x="60" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#6b7a8f">expedientes</text></svg><div class="donut-legend">'+legend+'</div></div>';
  }
  var catTab=window._dashCatTab||'ND';
  body.innerHTML=
    '<div class="dash-kpis">'+
      '<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-n">'+total+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Documentos generados</div></div>'+
      '<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-n">'+expedientes+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Expedientes únicos</div></div>'+
      '<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-n">'+regiones+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Regiones activas</div></div>'+
      '<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-n">'+usuarios+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Usuarios activos</div></div>'+
    '</div>'+
    buildChileMap(log)+
    '<div class="dash-chart-row" style="margin-top:18px;">'+
      '<div class="chart-card"><h4>Ὄ2 Expedientes por Categoría</h4>'+mkDonut([['ND',byCat.ND],['NR',byCat.NR],['Certificados',byCat.Certificados]].filter(function(d){return d[1]>0;}))+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="chart-card"><h4>ὌA Top Regiones</h4><div class="bar-chart">'+
      regionRows.slice(0,8).map(function(r,i){return mkBar(r[0],r[1],maxR,COLORS[i%COLORS.length]);}).join('')+'</div></div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="chart-card" style="margin-bottom:18px;">'+
      '<h4>📋 Tipos de Documento por Categoría</h4>'+
      '<div class="chart-tabs" id="dash-cat-tabs">'+
        ['ND','NR','Certificados'].map(function(cat){
          return '<button class="chart-tab'+(cat===catTab?' active':'')+'" onclick="setDashCatTab(\''+cat+'\')">'+cat+' ('+byCat[cat]+')</button>';
        }).join('')+
      '</div>'+
      '<div id="dash-cat-detail">'+buildCatDetail(catTab,getDocsByCat,COLORS,mkBar)+'</div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="dash-section"><h4>👤 Por Usuario</h4>'+
      '<table class="dash-table"><thead><tr><th>Usuario</th><th>Nombre</th><th>Región</th><th>Total</th><th>ND</th><th>NR</th><th>Cert.</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
      userRows.map(function(r){
        var ul=log.filter(function(l){return l.user===r[0];});
        var und=ul.filter(function(l){return getCategory(l.docName)==='ND';}).length;
        var unr=ul.filter(function(l){return getCategory(l.docName)==='NR';}).length;
        var uct=ul.filter(function(l){return getCategory(l.docName)==='Certificados';}).length;
        return '<tr><td>'+r[0]+'</td><td>'+r[1].nombre+'</td><td>'+r[1].region+'</td><td><strong>'+r[1].n+'</strong></td><td>'+und+'</td><td>'+unr+'</td><td>'+uct+'</td></tr>';
      }).join('')+
      '</tbody></table></div>';
}

function buildCatDetail(cat,getDocsByCat,COLORS,mkBar){
  var rows=getDocsByCat(cat);
  if(!rows.length)return '<div style="color:var(--su);font-size:12px;padding:8px;">Sin datos.</div>';
  var max=rows[0][1];
  return '<div class="bar-chart">'+rows.map(function(r,i){return mkBar(r[0],r[1],max,COLORS[i%COLORS.length]);}).join('')+'</div>';
}
function setDashCatTab(cat){
  window._dashCatTab=cat;
  document.querySelectorAll('.chart-tab').forEach(function(btn){btn.classList.toggle('active',btn.textContent.indexOf(cat)===0);});
  renderDash();
}
function exportDashReport(){
  var log=getFilteredLog(true);
  if(!log.length){alert('No hay datos para exportar.');return;}
  var csv='Fecha,Expediente,N° SSD,Usuario,Nombre,Región,Documento\n';
  log.forEach(function(l){csv+='"'+l.date+'","'+l.exp+'","'+(l.ssd||'—')+'","'+l.user+'","'+l.nombre+'","'+l.region+'","'+l.docName+'"\n';});
  try{
    var blob=new Blob(['﻿'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
    var a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    var desde=document.getElementById('df-desde').value||'';
    var hasta=document.getElementById('df-hasta').value||'';
    a.download='DARH_Reporte_'+desde+'_'+hasta+'.csv';
    document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }catch(e){alert('Error al exportar: '+e.message);}
}

  ["Arica y Parinacota","AP","M 62,2 L 140,2 L 144,8 L 141,55 L 135,58 L 60,56 L 58,30 Z"],
  ["Tarapacá","TA","M 58,58 L 135,58 L 138,65 L 132,115 L 125,120 L 54,118 L 52,88 Z"],

  ["Coquimbo","CO","M 30,352 L 85,352 L 89,360 L 70,430 L 55,438 L 20,436 L 18,394 Z"],
  ["Valparaíso","VA","M 18,438 L 55,438 L 58,446 L 42,490 L 28,496 L 10,492 L 8,462 Z"],
  ["Metropolitana","RM","M 8,494 L 28,496 L 30,504 L 18,535 L 8,540 L 0,534 L 0,510 Z"],
  ["O\'Higgins","LI","M 0,536 L 8,540 L 16,548 L 4,583 L 0,586 Z"],
  ["Maule","ML","M 0,586 L 4,585 L 10,590 L 0,630 Z"],
  ["Ñuble","NB","M 0,630 L 10,630 L 14,638 L 2,668 L 0,670 Z"],
  ["Biobío","BB","M 0,670 L 2,668 L 8,674 L 0,710 Z"],
  ["La Araucanía","AR","M 0,710 L 8,714 L 12,720 L 2,758 L 0,760 Z"],
  ["Los Ríos","LR","M 0,760 L 2,758 L 8,764 L 4,794 L 0,796 Z"],
  ["Los Lagos","LL","M 0,796 L 4,794 L 12,800 L 6,858 L 0,860 Z"],
  ["Aysén","AY","M 0,860 L 6,858 L 16,870 L 8,950 L 0,952 Z"],
  ["Magallanes","MG","M 0,952 L 8,950 L 20,965 L 10,1020 L 0,1026 Z"]
];

function buildChileMap(log){
  var byRegion={};
  REGION_COORDS.forEach(function(r){byRegion[r[0]]=0;});
  log.forEach(function(l){
    if(l.region&&byRegion[l.region]!==undefined)byRegion[l.region]++;
    else if(l.region)byRegion[l.region]=(byRegion[l.region]||0)+1;
  });
  var maxVal=Math.max.apply(null,Object.values(byRegion))||1;
  function getColor(n){
    if(n===0)return '#cddff0';
    var t=Math.sqrt(n/maxVal);
    return 'rgb('+Math.round(184-(184-0)*t)+','+Math.round(212-(212-63)*t)+','+Math.round(240-(240-138)*t)+')';
  }
  var svg='<svg width="100%" viewBox="0 0 210 1030" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;max-width:300px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;">';
  svg+='<rect x="0" y="0" width="210" height="1030" fill="#d0e8f5" rx="4"/>';
  REGION_COORDS.forEach(function(r){
    var name=r[0],abbr=r[1],pathD=r[2];
    var n=byRegion[name]||0;
    var fill=getColor(n);
    var ne=name.replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    svg+='<path d="'+pathD+'" fill="'+fill+'" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="0.8" style="cursor:pointer;" onmouseenter="mapTip(event,\''+ne+'\','+n+')" onmouseleave="mapTipHide()" onclick="mapFilter(\''+ne+'\')"/>';
    var pts=[],ms=pathD.match(/[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?,\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?/g)||[];
    ms.forEach(function(m){var p=m.split(',');pts.push([parseFloat(p[0]),parseFloat(p[1])]);});
    var cx=pts.length?pts.reduce(function(s,p){return s+p[0];},0)/pts.length:100;
    var cy=pts.length?pts.reduce(function(s,p){return s+p[1];},0)/pts.length:400;
    cx=Math.min(cx,148);
    svg+='<text x="'+cx.toFixed(0)+'" y="'+(cy+2).toFixed(0)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="5.5" fill="#fff" font-weight="700" font-family="Arial" pointer-events="none">'+abbr+'</text>';
    if(n>0)svg+='<text x="'+cx.toFixed(0)+'" y="'+(cy+9).toFixed(0)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="5" fill="#fff" font-family="Arial" pointer-events="none">'+n+'</text>';
  });
  svg+='</svg>';
  var scaleHTML='';
  for(var i=0;i<5;i++)scaleHTML+='<div style="background:'+getColor(Math.round(maxVal*i/4))+';flex:1;height:12px;"></div>';
  var sorted=REGION_COORDS.map(function(r){return{name:r[0],n:byRegion[r[0]]||0};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.n-a.n;});
  var listHTML=sorted.map(function(r){
    return '<div class="map-region-item" onclick="mapFilter(\''+r.name.replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\')"><div class="map-region-dot" style="background:'+getColor(r.n)+'"></div><div class="map-region-name">'+r.name+'</div><div class="map-region-count">'+r.n+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  return '<div class="chile-map-wrap"><h4>🗺 Mapa de Expedientes por Región</h4>'+
    '<div class="map-container"><div class="map-svg-wrap" style="min-height:380px;">'+svg+'</div>'+
    '<div class="map-legend">'+
      '<div class="map-legend-title">Expedientes</div>'+
      '<div style="display:flex;height:12px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:4px;">'+scaleHTML+'</div>'+
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;color:var(--su);margin-bottom:10px;"><span>0</span><span>'+Math.round(maxVal/2)+'</span><span>'+maxVal+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="map-region-list">'+listHTML+'</div>'+
    '</div></div></div>';
}

function mapTip(e,name,count){
  var t=document.getElementById('map-tooltip');
  if(!t)return;
  t.textContent=name+': '+count+' expediente'+(count!==1?'s':'');
  t.style.display='block';t.style.left=(e.clientX+12)+'px';t.style.top=(e.clientY-8)+'px';
}
function mapTipHide(){var t=document.getElementById('map-tooltip');if(t)t.style.display='none';}
function mapFilter(regionName){
  var sel=document.getElementById('df-region');if(!sel)return;
  sel.value=(sel.value===regionName)?'':regionName;renderDash();
}

// MOBILE NAV
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var mobCurrent='menu';
function isMobile(){return window.innerWidth<=900;}
function mobTab(panel){
  if(!isMobile())return;
  mobCurrent=panel;
  // Use getElementById for reliability on Safari iOS
  var mc=document.getElementById('panel-menu');
  var fc=document.getElementById('panel-form');
  var pc=document.getElementById('panel-preview');
  // Toggle panel visibility via mob-active class
  if(mc){if(panel==='menu'){mc.classList.add('mob-active');}else{mc.classList.remove('mob-active');}}
  if(fc){if(panel==='form'){fc.classList.add('mob-active');}else{fc.classList.remove('mob-active');}}
  if(pc){if(panel==='preview'){pc.classList.add('mob-active');}else{pc.classList.remove('mob-active');}}
  // Tab indicator: data-active attribute (works on Safari)
  ['menu','form','preview'].forEach(function(p){
    var el=document.getElementById('tab-'+p);
    if(!el)return;
    if(p===panel){el.setAttribute('data-active','1');}
    else{el.removeAttribute('data-active');}
  });
}

function initMobile(){
  var hdr=document.querySelector('.hdr');
  if(hdr)document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--hdr-h',hdr.offsetHeight+'px');
  if(isMobile()){
    var mc=document.getElementById('panel-menu');if(mc)mc.classList.add('mob-active');
    var tabs=document.getElementById('mob-tabs');if(tabs)tabs.style.display='flex';
    mobTab('menu');
  }
}
window.addEventListener('load',initMobile);
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
  var hdr=document.querySelector('.hdr');
  if(hdr)document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--hdr-h',hdr.offsetHeight+'px');
  if(!isMobile()){
    var mc=document.getElementById('panel-menu'),fc=document.getElementById('panel-form'),pc=document.getElementById('panel-preview');
    if(mc){mc.classList.remove('mob-active');mc.style.transform='';}
    if(fc){fc.classList.remove('mob-active');fc.style.transform='';}
    if(pc){pc.classList.remove('mob-active');pc.style.transform='';}
  }
});


document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
  var sel=document.querySelector('.um-reg');
  if(sel){['Nacional'].concat(Object.keys(GEO)).forEach(function(r){var opt=document.createElement('option');opt.value=r;opt.textContent=r;sel.appendChild(opt);});}
  var userEl=document.getElementById('login-user');
  var passEl=document.getElementById('login-pass');
  if(userEl)userEl.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'&&passEl)passEl.focus();});
  if(passEl)passEl.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter')doLogin();});
  var saved=_lsGet(SESSION_KEY);
  if(saved){try{var u=JSON.parse(saved);var fresh=getUsers().find(function(x){return x.user===u.user;});if(fresh){currentUser=fresh;var overlay=document.getElementById('login-overlay');if(overlay)overlay.style.display='none';var badge=document.getElementById('user-badge');if(badge)badge.style.display='flex';var bname=document.getElementById('user-badge-name');if(bname)bname.textContent=fresh.nombre.split(' ')[0];var upname=document.getElementById('up-name');if(upname)upname.textContent=fresh.nombre;var upreg=document.getElementById('up-region');if(upreg)upreg.textContent=fresh.region;var uprol=document.getElementById('up-rol');if(uprol)uprol.textContent=fresh.rol==='super'?'Superusuario':'Regional';if(fresh.rol==='super'){var bm=document.getElementById('btn-mgr-users');if(bm)bm.style.display='flex';var bd=document.getElementById('btn-dashboard');if(bd)bd.style.display='flex';}var slot=document.getElementById('user-badge-slot');var badgeEl=document.getElementById('user-badge');if(slot&&badgeEl)slot.appendChild(badgeEl);}}catch(e){_lsDel(SESSION_KEY);}}
});

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function opts(a){return a.map(function(x){return'<option value="'+x+'">'+x+'</option>';}).join("");}
function v(id){var e=document.getElementById(id);return e?e.value:"";}
// vn: lector para campos de caudal/vol — acepta coma o punto como separador decimal
// Se muestra tal como el usuario lo escribe (sin conversión)
function vn(id){return v(id);}
function fmtShort(s){if(!s)return"[dd de mmm de año]";var d=new Date(s+"T12:00:00");return(d.getDate()<10?"0":"")+d.getDate()+"/"+(d.getMonth()+1<10?"0":"")+(d.getMonth()+1)+"/"+String(d.getFullYear()).slice(-2);}
function fmtLong(s){if(!s)return"[dd de mmm de año]";var d=new Date(s+"T12:00:00");var m=["enero","febrero","marzo","abril","mayo","junio","julio","agosto","septiembre","octubre","noviembre","diciembre"];return d.getDate()+" de "+m[d.getMonth()]+" de "+d.getFullYear();}
function hn(x,f){return'<span class="hl-nom">'+(x||f)+'</span>';}
function hl2(x,f){return'<span class="hl-lugar">'+(x||f)+'</span>';}
function hf(x,f){return'<span class="hl-fecha">'+(x||f)+'</span>';}
function hd(x,f){return'<span class="hl-der">'+(x||f)+'</span>';}
function he(x,f){return'<span class="hl-exp">'+(x||f)+'</span>';}
function tSec(h){
  if(typeof h==='string') h=document.getElementById(h);
  if(!h) return;
  h.classList.toggle("open");
  if(h.nextElementSibling) h.nextElementSibling.classList.toggle("open");
}
function tFolder(h){
  if(typeof h==='string') h=document.getElementById(h);
  if(!h) return;
  h.classList.toggle("fopen");
  if(h.nextElementSibling) h.nextElementSibling.classList.toggle("fopen");
}
function markManual(id){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.dataset.manual="1";}
function manualDir(){markManual("f_dir");render();}
function manualTel(){markManual("f_tel");render();}
var _n=0; function resetN(){_n=0;}

// ── Geography ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function uProv(){
  var reg=v("f_region");
  var ps=document.getElementById("f_prov");
  var cs=document.getElementById("f_com");
  if(!ps)return;
  ps.innerHTML='<option value="">— Seleccione —</option>';
  if(cs)cs.innerHTML='<option value="">— Seleccione —</option>';
  if(reg&&GEO[reg]){Object.keys(GEO[reg]).forEach(function(p){ps.innerHTML+='<option value="'+p+'">'+p+'</option>';});}
  // Actualizar dirección y teléfono automáticamente según región
  if(reg&&typeof DGA_DIR!=='undefined'&&DGA_DIR[reg]){
    _autoDir=DGA_DIR[reg].dir||'';
    _autoTel=DGA_DIR[reg].tel||'';
  } else {
    _autoDir=''; _autoTel='';
  }
  render();
}
function uCom(){
  var reg=v("f_region"),prov=v("f_prov");
  var cs=document.getElementById("f_com");
  if(!cs)return;
  cs.innerHTML='<option value="">— Seleccione —</option>';
  if(reg&&prov&&GEO[reg]&&GEO[reg][prov]){GEO[reg][prov].forEach(function(com){cs.innerHTML+='<option value="'+com+'">'+com+'</option>';});}
  // Si solo hay una opción, seleccionarla automáticamente
  if(cs.options.length===2)cs.selectedIndex=1;
  if(typeof autoFillCBR==='function')autoFillCBR();
  if(typeof autoFillPTCbr==='function')autoFillPTCbr();
  if(typeof itnCbrAutofill==='function')itnCbrAutofill();
  render();
}

// ── Preview builders ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildHeader(f,refText){
  // Auto-bold first word(s) of REF if not already bold
  var _ref=refText||'';
  if(_ref && _ref.indexOf('<strong>')<0){
    var _refKeys=['DECLARA ADMISIBLE Y DENIEGA','DECLARA ADMISIBLE DESDE INADMISIBLE',
      'DECLARA ADMISIBLE','DECLARA INADMISIBLE Y DENIEGA','DECLARA INADMISIBLE',
      'DENIEGA','OTORGA CONCESIÓN EN PARTE','OTORGA CONCESIÓN PROVISIONAL EN PARTE',
      'OTORGA CONCESIÓN PROVISIONAL','OTORGA CONCESIÓN','OTORGA','RECONOCE',
      'TÉNGASE POR DESISTIDA','CERTIFICA','RECHAZA OPOSICIÓN','ACOGE OPOSICIÓN'];
    for(var _i=0;_i<_refKeys.length;_i++){
      if(_ref.indexOf(_refKeys[_i])===0){
        _ref='<strong>'+_refKeys[_i]+'</strong>'+_ref.slice(_refKeys[_i].length);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  var _rk=['DECLARA ADMISIBLE Y DENIEGA','DECLARA ADMISIBLE DESDE INADMISIBLE',
    'DECLARA ADMISIBLE','DECLARA INADMISIBLE Y DENIEGA','DECLARA INADMISIBLE',
    'DENIEGA','OTORGA CONCESIÓN EN PARTE','OTORGA CONCESIÓN PROVISIONAL EN PARTE',
    'OTORGA CONCESIÓN PROVISIONAL','OTORGA CONCESIÓN','OTORGA','RECONOCE',
    'TÉNGASE POR DESISTIDA','CERTIFICA NO OPOSICIÓN','RECHAZA OPOSICIÓN','ACOGE OPOSICIÓN'];
  var _rt=refText||'';
  if(_rt&&_rt.indexOf('<strong>')<0){
    for(var _ri=0;_ri<_rk.length;_ri++){
      if(_rt.indexOf(_rk[_ri])===0){_rt='<strong>'+_rk[_ri]+'</strong>'+_rt.slice(_rk[_ri].length);break;}
    }
  }
  var ref=_rt?'<div class="p-ref" contenteditable="true"><strong>REF.:</strong>&nbsp;'+_rt+'</div>':''
  return '<div class="p-header">'+
    '<div class="p-logo-col">'+
      '<img class="p-logo" src="'+LOGO+'" alt="DGA">'+
      '<div class="p-logo-meta">'+
        '<p contenteditable="true"><u><strong>N°</strong></u> de Proceso: '+he(f.ssd,'[SSD Res]')+'</p>'+
        '<p contenteditable="true">Expediente: '+he(f.exp,'ND-xxxx-xxxx')+'</p>'+
      '</div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="p-title-col">'+
      ref+
      '<div class="p-resol-num" contenteditable="true">'+
        '<strong>DGA '+hl2(f.region,'[región]')+' (Exenta) N°&nbsp;'+he(f.nres,'[xxx]')+'</strong>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="p-city" contenteditable="true">'+
        '<strong>'+he(f.ciudad,'[CIUDAD]')+', '+hf(f.fRes,'[dd de mmm de año]')+'.</strong>'+
      '</div>'+
    '</div>'+
  '</div>';
}

    '</div>';
  return '<div class="p-footer" style="margin-top:8pt;border-top:1pt solid #000;padding-top:4pt;font-size:9pt;text-align:center;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;">'+
    '<div contenteditable="true">Dirección General de Aguas - Departamento de Administración de Recursos Hídricos</div>'+

function buildFooter(f){

  var barra='<div class="footer-barra" style="text-align:center;margin-top:3pt;">'+
    '<span style="display:inline-block;width:50px;height:4px;background:#003F8A;vertical-align:middle;"></span>'+
    '<span style="display:inline-block;width:50px;height:4px;background:#CC2030;vertical-align:middle;"></span>'+
    '</div>';
  return '<div class="p-footer" style="margin-top:8pt;border-top:1pt solid #000;padding-top:4pt;font-size:9pt;text-align:center;font-family:Calibri,Carlito,Arial,sans-serif;page-break-inside:avoid;break-inside:avoid;">'+

    '<div contenteditable="true">'+hl2(f.dir,"[Dirección of. regional]")+' - Teléfono '+he(f.tel,"(56-x) [xxx]")+' - dga.mop.gob.cl</div>'+
    barra+

function ni(n,txt){
  return '<div class="p-item" contenteditable="true"><span class="p-num-lbl"><strong>'+n+'.</strong></span><span class="p-item-text">'+txt+'</span></div>';
}
// Texto de "Características del derecho 2": misma estructura que la característica 1,
// pero usando los campos *_2. Solo debe usarse si f.hasCarac2 es true.
function carac2Clause(f){
  return 'Asimismo, para uso '+hd(f.uso2,'[uso]')+', de carácter '+hd(f.nat2,'[consuntivo/no consuntivo]')+', ejercicio '+hd(f.eje2,'[permanente/eventual]')+', frecuencia '+hd(f.frec2,'[continuo/discontinuo/alternado]')+', por un caudal de '+he(f.caudal2,'xxx')+' litros por segundo y un volumen total anual de '+he(f.vol2,'xxx')+' metros cúbicos, a extraer desde un '+he(f.obra2,'[pozo/obra]')+'.';
}
// Variante para Aguas Superficiales (ND Sup / VPC superficial): usa cauce2 en vez de obra2/vol2.
function carac2ClauseSUP(f){
  return 'Asimismo, para aguas'+(f.tipoAgua2?' '+hd(f.tipoAgua2,''):'')+', uso '+hd(f.uso2,'[uso]')+', de carácter '+hd(f.nat2,'[consuntivo/no consuntivo]')+', ejercicio '+hd(f.eje2,'[permanente/eventual]')+', frecuencia '+hd(f.frec2,'[continuo/discontinuo/alternado]')+', por un caudal de '+he(f.caudal2,'xxx')+' litros por segundo, a extraer desde un '+hd(f.cauce2,'cauce/estero')+'.';
}
// Arma una lista de ni() numerados, insertando carac2Clause justo después del índice 'insertAfter'
// (0-based) si f.hasCarac2 es true. El resto se renumera automáticamente.
function resuelvoList(items,insertAfter,f){
  var out='', rn=1;
  for(var k=0;k<items.length;k++){
    out+=ni(rn++, items[k]);
    if(k===insertAfter && f.hasCarac2) out+=ni(rn++, carac2Clause(f));
  }
  return out;
}

// ── Field readers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getFields(){
  return {
    nombre:v("f_nombre")||"[nombre]", trat:v("f_trat")||"don/doña/razón social",
    region:v("f_region")||"[región]", prov:v("f_prov")||"[provincia]",
    com:v("f_com")||"[comuna]", ciudad:v("f_ciudad")||"[CIUDAD]",
    exp:v("f_exp")||"ND-xxxx-xxxx", ssd:v("f_ssd")||"[SSD]",
    nres:v("f_nres")||"[xxx]", email:v("f_email")||"xxxx@xxx.xx",
    dirSol:v("f_dir_sol")||"[dirección del solicitante]",
    uso:v("f_uso")||"[uso]", nat:v("f_nat")||"[consuntivo/no consuntivo]",
    eje:v("f_eje")||"[permanente/eventual]",
    frec:v("f_frec")||"[continuo/discontinuo/alternado]",
    caudal:vn("f_caudal")||"xxx", vol:vn("f_vol")||"xxx", obra:v("f_obra")||"[pozo/obra]",
    uso2:v("f_uso2"), nat2:v("f_nat2")||"[consuntivo/no consuntivo]",
    eje2:v("f_eje2")||"[permanente/eventual]",
    frec2:v("f_frec2")||"[continuo/discontinuo/alternado]",
    caudal2:vn("f_caudal2")||"xxx", vol2:vn("f_vol2")||"xxx", obra2:v("f_obra2")||"[pozo/obra]",
